stats.Effect: The leader of the vanguard of angels that punished Baium and broke down the Tower of Insolence. He actively works to hold back the devils that smashed through the upper floors of the Tower of Insolence. He guides Kel Mahums of the Platinum Tribe into war against the devils for control of the Tower of Insolence. He is called the Fire of Wrath for he wields the sword of judgment without hesitation, compassion or mercy.
